end.parentNote: Asha practised naming polygons by counting sides and recognising shapes when they were rotated or different sizes. Veer explained that a polygon has connected sides with no gaps, and this method supported correct shape recognition. The triangle description by equal sides and angle types was not yet secured; the equilateral-triangle term was recalled uncertainly and was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Veer to sort drawn shapes by side count, then describe one triangle by its side lengths and angles.
